about.heading: About The H.E.L.F Review
about.text: Published by the Higher Education Leadership Foundation, The H.E.L.F Review delivers news, analysis, and commentary on the trends, challenges, and leaders shaping Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) and higher education broadly — going beyond H.E.L.F.'s own mission to cover the issues defining the field today.

editor.name: Dr. Jamal Watson
editor.bio: Dr. Jamal Watson is the editor of The H.E.L.F Review. An award-winning journalist and author, Watson previously served as the executive editor of Diverse: Issues In Higher Education. He is currently a professor and associate dean of graduate studies at Trinity Washington University.
